observations: ZERO_DOC_BOOTSTRAP mode: no OpenAPI/static contract found anywhere in scope for these endpoints. Every 'contract' field below is OBSERVED_CURRENT from a single runtime sample unless stated otherwise -- treat as baseline, not as confirmed required/optional shape.

portal-evidence.json cites the SAME network capture file (raw/network/ACT-01-01-006.json) for two different ACT-IDs (ACT-01-01-001 'create artwork' and ACT-01-01-006 'Save & Close'). Only one POST /api/artworks entry exists in that file. Treated as one operation mapped to both ACT-IDs; likely portal-explorer attached the same evidence file to both steps of one logical create-then-save flow rather than two separate HTTP calls -- not independently confirmed.

raw/network/ACT-05-01-003.json bundles evidence for 4 distinct UI surfaces related to clipart-category listing, only 2 of which have an actual captured HTTP/GraphQL request. The other 2 (the working 'Search' modal, and the group layer's 'Group's default value' combobox) have no method/URL captured at all -- moved to unexplored_operations rather than fabricated.

No request body was captured for POST /api/artworks, PUT /api/artworks/{id}, POST /api/artworks/{id}/validate-default-value, POST /api/users/{id}/temporary-files/upload-url, or POST /api/cliparts/by-temporary-file in any provided network file -- only response bodies (and for validate-default-value, only status). Request contracts for these are marked unknown, not inferred from the response.
Every operation in this batch has observed_count of 1 or 2 (max). Per counting rule, no field is marked always_present anywhere in this artifact.

Not independently verified for POST .../validate-default-value, POST .../temporary-files/upload-url, POST /api/cliparts/by-temporary-file, or the campaign calls in ACT-06-01-002.json.
unknowns: Whether GET /api/layer-image-categories?type=clipart is also invoked when opening the add-layer asset picker for a group-clipart-categories layer (ACT-01-02-001) -- no network_ref was attached to that action, so only the clipart-category (single) add-layer flow (ACT-01-01-002) is confirmed to trigger this endpoint.

Exact request/response shape of the working 'Search' category-picker modal (distinct from the broken inline 'Search top-level category' textbox) -- functionally confirmed to return categories with thumbnails (per portal-explorer qualitative note) but no method/URL/body was captured for it in any provided file.

Exact request/response shape (or even whether any network call fires) behind the group-clipart-categories layer's 'Group's default value' combobox showing 'List is empty.' -- no distinguishing request was isolated in the capture.

Whether the ACT-01-02-004.json PUT /api/artworks/4339 response omitting fields (url, required, fit_mode, direct_upload_style, direct_clipart_style, shadow_display, schema_version) on the 'cat1' (clipart-category) layer -- present in the earlier ACT-01-01-006.json response for the same layer -- reflects an actual server-side field removal/change, or is simply a partial/trimmed capture by portal-explorer when writing the evidence file. Not enough evidence to conclude either way; recorded as a LOW-confidence state_delta, not a confirmed field removal.

Whether category field `show_clipart_name` (observed null, POST /api/clipart-categories response) is in fact the backing field for the UI toggle 'Show option name on hover' documented by portal-explorer -- plausible name correspondence only, never toggled/tested in this run, so mapping is INFERRED not confirmed.

Whether 'Preview size' (clipart_max_width) and 'Thumbnail size' (clipart_thumbnail_size) are stored/interpreted as raw pixel integers by the API, or whether the API applies any unit conversion -- the API payload itself carries no unit; px is only asserted by the UI select labels observed by portal-explorer, not by the API contract.

No PUT/update endpoint for an EXISTING clipart-category was observed in this run's network captures -- the Thumbnail size 100->300 change was submitted as part of the category's initial POST /api/clipart-categories (create) call, not as a subsequent update to an already-created category. The 'category update endpoint when changing Thumbnail size 100->300' requested in TASK-6 item 4 could not be located in the provided evidence; it may not have been captured (portal-explorer changed the value in the create form before first submit, rather than editing after creation).

No dedicated 'generate/return image variant by size' endpoint was observed. Only static, already-generated URL path suffixes were seen embedded in artwork/layer JSON: master (no suffix), '<hash>_large.webp', '<hash>_thumbnail.webp'. Whether these 3 variants are generated synchronously at upload time, on first request, or via a background job is not observable from the API evidence provided (would require inspecting the temporary-files/upload-url or by-temporary-file response bodies in full, which were not captured beyond status + a few top-level fields).

Not resolved here.

side_a.claim: Returns response_status 200 with body `[]` (empty array), fired when opening the add-layer asset picker's 'Choose from clipart category' tab.

side_b.source: raw/network/ACT-05-01-003.json entry 2 -- POST /api/graphql, query aliased `categories: clipart_categories(where: {type: clipart, deleted_at: null, parent_id: null}, limit: 25)`

Root cause (filter difference on the REST endpoint, e.g. a hidden flag/FK the GraphQL query does not filter on, vs a staging data/cache issue) is NOT diagnosed here -- see documented_observed_mismatches and payload.unexplored_operations; db-explorer follow-up recommended per portal-evidence's own note.
